questions.text: यदि बहुपद p(x) = 2x² − k√2 x + 1 के शून्यकों का योगफल √2 है, तो k का मान है:
questions.text_english: If the sum of zeroes of the polynomial p(x) = 2x² − k√2 x + 1 is √2, then value of k is:
questions.solution: For a quadratic polynomial ax² + bx + c, sum of zeroes = −b/a. Here a = 2, b = −k√2, so sum = k√2/2. Setting k√2/2 = √2 gives k = 2. Option B is correct. Option A gives sum = 1, option C gives sum = 2, option D gives sum = 1/2, none of which equal √2.
questions.topic: Sum of zeroes of a quadratic polynomial

questions.text: यदि एक खिलाड़ी के एक खेल को जीतने की प्रायिकता 0.79 है, तो उसके, उसी खेल को हारने की प्रायिकता है:
questions.text_english: If the probability of a player winning a game is 0.79, then the probability of his losing the same game is:
questions.solution: P(losing) = 1 − P(winning) = 1 − 0.79 = 0.21. Option D is correct. Option A (1.79) exceeds 1 so is impossible. Option B (0.31) is incorrect arithmetic. Option C expresses the answer as a percentage, which is not a valid probability value.

questions.text: यदि समीकरण ax² + bx + c = 0, a ≠ 0 के मूल वास्तविक और समान हैं, तो निम्न में से कौनसा संबंध सही है?
questions.text_english: If the roots of equation ax² + bx + c = 0, a ≠ 0 are real and equal, then which of the following relation is true?
questions.solution: For real and equal roots, discriminant D = b² − 4ac = 0, which gives b² = 4ac, or equivalently ac = b²/4. Option C is correct. Option B (b² = ac) is incorrect as it omits the factor 4. Options A and D do not follow from the discriminant condition.

questions.text: एक समांतर श्रेढ़ी में यदि प्रथम पद a = 7, nवां पद aₙ = 84 तथा प्रथम n पदों का योग sₙ = 2093/2 है, तो n का मान है:
questions.text_english: In an A.P., if the first term a = 7, nth term aₙ = 84 and the sum of first n terms sₙ = 2093/2, then n is equal to:
questions.solution: Using Sₙ = n/2 × (a + aₙ): 2093/2 = n/2 × (7 + 84) = n/2 × 91. So n = 2093/91 = 23. Option C is correct. The other options (22, 24, 26) do not satisfy the equation Sₙ = n(91)/2 = 2093/2.
questions.topic: Sum of n terms of AP

questions.text: यदि दो घन पूर्णांकों p तथा q को p = 18 a²b⁴ तथा q = 20 a³b² के रूप में लिखा जा सकता है, जहाँ a तथा b अभाज्य संख्याएं हैं, तो LCM (p, q) है:
questions.text_english: If two positive integers p and q can be expressed as p = 18 a²b⁴ and q = 20 a³b², where a and b are prime numbers, then LCM (p, q) is:
questions.solution: p = 18 a²b⁴ = 2 × 3² × a²b⁴ and q = 20 a³b² = 2² × 5 × a³b². LCM takes the highest power of each prime factor: 2² × 3² × 5 × a³ × b⁴ = 4 × 9 × 5 × a³b⁴ = 180 a³b⁴. Option D is correct. Options A, B, C all use lower powers of a or b.

questions.text: त्रिभुज ABC के शीर्ष A(5, −6), B(6, 4) तथा C(0, 0) हैं तथा AD त्रिभुज की एक माध्यिका है। AD की लंबाई है:
questions.text_english: AD is a median of △ABC with vertices A(5, −6), B(6, 4) and C(0, 0). Length AD is equal to:
questions.topic: Median length using midpoint and distance formula

questions.text: यदि sec θ − tan θ = m है, तो sec θ + tan θ का मान है:
questions.text_english: If sec θ − tan θ = m, then the value of sec θ + tan θ is:
questions.solution: Using the identity sec²θ − tan²θ = 1, we get (sec θ − tan θ)(sec θ + tan θ) = 1. Since sec θ − tan θ = m, it follows that sec θ + tan θ = 1/m. Option C is correct. The other options do not satisfy this fundamental trigonometric identity.

questions.text: आँकड़ों 1, 4, 7, 9, 16, 21, 25 में से यदि सभी सम संख्याएँ निकाल दी गई हों, तो शेष में यादृच्छया एक अभाज्य संख्या आने की प्रायिकता है:
questions.text_english: From the data 1, 4, 7, 9, 16, 21, 25, if all the even numbers are removed, then the probability of getting at random a prime number from the remaining is:
questions.solution: Removing even numbers (4, 16) leaves {1, 7, 9, 21, 25} — 5 numbers. Among these, only 7 is prime (1 is not prime; 9 = 3², 21 = 3×7, 25 = 5² are composite). P(prime) = 1/5. Option B is correct.

questions.text: किन्हीं आँकड़ों x₁, x₂, …… xₙ जहाँ f₁, f₂, …… fₙ क्रमशः उनकी बारंबारताएँ हैं, के लिए Σ fᵢ(xᵢ − x̄) का मान है:
questions.text_english: For some data x₁, x₂, ...... xₙ with respective frequencies f₁, f₂, ...... fₙ, the value of Σ fᵢ(xᵢ − x̄) is equal to:
questions.solution: By the definition of the mean, Σfᵢxᵢ = x̄ · Σfᵢ. Therefore Σfᵢ(xᵢ − x̄) = Σfᵢxᵢ − x̄·Σfᵢ = x̄·Σfᵢ − x̄·Σfᵢ = 0. Option D is correct, as the sum of deviations from the mean is always zero.

questions.text: यदि बहुपद x² + px + q के शून्यक, बहुपद 4x² − 5x − 6 के शून्यकों के दुगने के बराबर हैं, तो p का मान है:
questions.text_english: The zeroes of a polynomial x² + px + q are twice the zeroes of the polynomial 4x² − 5x − 6. The value of p is:
questions.solution: For 4x² − 5x − 6, sum of zeroes = 5/4. The zeroes of x² + px + q are twice these, so their sum = 5/2. Since sum of zeroes of x² + px + q = −p, we get −p = 5/2, so p = −5/2. Wait — rechecking: −p/1 = 5/2 gives p = −5/2. But option C is −5. Let me re-examine: if both zeroes are doubled, new sum = 2×(5/4) = 5/2, and −p = 5/2, so p = −5/2, which is option A. The correct answer is A (−5/2).

questions.text: यदि बिंदुओं (3, −5) तथा (x, −5) के बीच की दूरी 15 इकाई है, तो x के मान हैं:
questions.text_english: If the distance between the points (3, −5) and (x, −5) is 15 units, then the values of x are:
questions.solution: Since the y-coordinates are equal, distance = |x − 3| = 15. This gives x − 3 = 15 or x − 3 = −15, so x = 18 or x = −12. Option B (−12, 18) is correct. Options A, C, D do not both satisfy |x − 3| = 15.

questions.text: यदि cos(α + β) = 0 है, तो cos((α + β)/2) का मान है:
questions.text_english: If cos(α + β) = 0, then value of cos((α + β)/2) is equal to:
questions.solution: cos(α + β) = 0 implies α + β = 90°. Therefore (α + β)/2 = 45°, and cos 45° = 1/√2. Option A is correct. Options B, C, D correspond to cos 60°, cos 90°, and an invalid cosine value respectively.

questions.text: एक ठोस गोले को दो अर्धगोलों में काटा गया। इस गोले के पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल का दोनों अर्धगोलों के संपूर्ण पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल से अनुपात है:
questions.text_english: A solid sphere is cut into two hemispheres. The ratio of the surface areas of sphere to that of two hemispheres taken together, is:
questions.solution: Surface area of sphere = 4πr². Each hemisphere has curved surface area πr² + flat circular area πr² = 3πr². Two hemispheres together = 6πr² (but the flat faces are internal, so total = 2×3πr² = 6πr²? No — each hemisphere total surface area = 2πr² + πr² = 3πr², so two together = 6πr²). Ratio = 4πr² : 6πr² = 2:3. Option C is correct.
questions.topic: Surface area of sphere and hemisphere

questions.text: प्रत्येक प्रकार के आँकड़ों को क्रम में व्यवस्थित करने पर सबसे बीच का प्रेक्षण होता है:
questions.text_english: The middle most observation of every data arranged in order is called:
questions.solution: By definition, the median is the middle value when data is arranged in ascending or descending order. Option B is correct. Mode is the most frequently occurring value, mean is the arithmetic average, and deviation measures spread — none of these represent the middle observation.

questions.text: भुजा 2 cm वाले एक ठोस घन से काटकर निकाले जा सकने वाले अधिकतम आयतन के शंकु का आयतन है:
questions.text_english: The volume of the largest right circular cone that can be carved out from a solid cube of edge 2 cm is:
questions.solution: The largest cone carved from a cube of edge 2 cm has base diameter = 2 cm (radius r = 1 cm) and height h = 2 cm. Volume = (1/3)πr²h = (1/3)π(1)²(2) = 2π/3 cu cm. Option D is correct. Options A, B, C use incorrect values of radius or height.

questions.text: दो पासों को एक साथ उछाला गया। दोनों पासों पर आई संख्याओं का योग 2, 3 या 5 आने की प्रायिकता है:
questions.text_english: Two dice are rolled together. The probability of getting sum of numbers on the two dice as 2, 3 or 5, is:
questions.solution: Total outcomes = 36. Sum 2: {(1,1)} = 1 way. Sum 3: {(1,2),(2,1)} = 2 ways. Sum 5: {(1,4),(4,1),(2,3),(3,2)} = 4 ways. Total favourable = 1+2+4 = 7. P = 7/36. Option A is correct.

questions.text: एक वृत्त का केंद्र बिंदु (2, 0) पर है। यदि वृत्त के एक व्यास का एक सिरा बिंदु (6, 0) पर है, तो इसके दूसरे सिरे के निर्देशांक हैं:
questions.text_english: The centre of a circle is at (2, 0). If one end of a diameter is at (6, 0), then the other end is at:
questions.solution: The centre is the midpoint of the diameter. If one end is (6, 0) and centre is (2, 0), then the other end (x, y) satisfies (6+x)/2 = 2 and (0+y)/2 = 0. Solving: x = −2, y = 0. Option C (−2, 0) is correct.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में दो रैखिक समीकरणों का ग्राफ दर्शाया गया है। इन रैखिक समीकरणों का युग्म:
questions.text_english: In the given figure, graphs of two linear equations are shown. The pair of these linear equations is:

options.A: अद्वितीय हल के साथ संगत है। (consistent with unique solution.)
options.B: अपरिमित रूप से अनेक हलों के साथ संगत है। (consistent with infinitely many solutions.)
options.D: असंगत है परन्तु रेखाओं को बढ़ाने पर संगत बनाया जा सकता है। (inconsistent but can be made consistent by extending these lines.)

options_english.D: inconsistent but can be made consistent by extending these lines.

questions.image_description: A coordinate plane showing two straight lines that intersect at a single point near the origin. Both lines have different slopes and clearly cross each other, indicating a unique solution.
questions.solution: From the figure, the two lines intersect at exactly one point, which means the system has a unique solution and is consistent. Option A is correct. If lines were parallel (no intersection) the system would be inconsistent; if they coincided, infinitely many solutions would exist.
questions.chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
questions.topic: Graphical interpretation of pair of linear equations

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A): वृत्त के किसी व्यास के सिरों पर खींची गई स्पर्श रेखाएँ परस्पर समांतर होती हैं।
तर्क (R): एक वृत्त का व्यास इसकी सबसे लम्बी जीवा होती है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): The tangents drawn at the end points of a diameter of a circle, are parallel.
Reason (R): Diameter of a circle is the longest chord.
questions.instruction_line: निर्देश: प्रश्न संख्या 19 तथा 20 में एक अभिकथन (A) के बाद एक तर्क (R) कथन दिया गया है। सही विकल्प चुनिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Directions: In Q. No. 19 and 20 a statement of Assertion (A) is followed by a statement of Reason (R). Choose the correct option.

options.A: दोनों, अभिकथन (A) तथा तर्क (R) सही हैं। तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: दोनों, अभिकथन (A) तथा तर्क (R) सही हैं परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है जबकि तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both, Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both, Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true but Reason (R) is not correct explanation for Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion A is true: tangents at the endpoints of a diameter are perpendicular to the radius at those points, so they are both perpendicular to the diameter and hence parallel to each other. Reason R is also true: the diameter is indeed the longest chord. However, R does not explain why the tangents are parallel — the correct explanation uses the property that a tangent is perpendicular to the radius, not the length of the chord. So option B is correct.

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A): यदि किसी बहुपद का ग्राफ x−अक्ष को केवल एक बिंदु पर स्पर्श करता है, तो यह द्विघात बहुपद नहीं हो सकता।
तर्क (R): घात n(n > 1) के बहुपद के अधिकतम शून्यक n होते हैं।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): If the graph of a polynomial touches x-axis at only one point, then the polynomial cannot be a quadratic polynomial.
Reason (R): A polynomial of degree n(n > 1) can have at most n zeroes.

options.A: दोनों, अभिकथन (A) तथा तर्क (R) सही हैं। तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: दोनों, अभिकथन (A) तथा तर्क (R) सही हैं परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है जबकि तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both, Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both, Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true but Reason (R) is not correct explanation for Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion A is false: a quadratic polynomial can touch the x-axis at exactly one point when it has equal roots (discriminant = 0), e.g. x² − 2x + 1 = (x−1)². Reason R is true: a polynomial of degree n has at most n zeroes. Since A is false and R is true, option D is correct.
questions.topic: Zeroes of a polynomial and graph

questions.text: निम्न रैखिक समीकरण निकाय का हल ज्ञात कीजिए: 7x − 2y = 5 तथा 8x + 7y = 15 और अपने उत्तर को सत्यापित कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Solve the following system of linear equations: 7x − 2y = 5 and 8x + 7y = 15 and verify your answer.
questions.solution: Multiply 7x − 2y = 5 by 7: 49x − 14y = 35. Multiply 8x + 7y = 15 by 2: 16x + 14y = 30. Adding: 65x = 65, so x = 1. Substituting: 7(1) − 2y = 5 gives y = 1. Verification: 7(1)−2(1)=5 ✓ and 8(1)+7(1)=15 ✓. Solution: x = 1, y = 1.
questions.chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables

questions.text: एक अच्छी प्रकार से फेंटी गई 52 पत्तों की ताश की गड्डी में से यादृच्छया एक पत्ता निकाला गया। यदि यह एक काले रंग का पत्ता है, तो इसे अलग रखकर शेष पत्तों में से एक पत्ता यादृच्छया निकाला गया। इस पत्ते के पान की बेगम वाला पत्ता आने की प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: In a pack of 52 playing cards one card is lost. From the remaining cards, a card is drawn at random. Find the probability that the drawn card is queen of heart, if the lost card is a black card.
questions.solution: After removing a black card, 51 cards remain. The queen of hearts (a red card) is still in the deck since the lost card is black. There is only 1 queen of hearts among the 51 remaining cards. Therefore, P(queen of hearts) = 1/51.

questions.text:
(A) मान ज्ञात कीजिए: 2√2 cos 45° sin 30° + 2√3 cos 30°
अथवा
(B) यदि A = 60° तथा B = 30° है, तो सत्यापित कीजिए कि: sin(A + B) = sin A cos B + cos A sin B
questions.text_english:
(A) Evaluate: 2√2 cos 45° sin 30° + 2√3 cos 30°
OR
(B) If A = 60° and B = 30°, verify that: sin(A + B) = sin A cos B + cos A sin B
questions.topic: Trigonometric ratios and compound angle identity

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, ABCD एक चतुर्भुज है जिसका विकर्ण BD, कोण B तथा कोण D को समद्विभाजित करता है। सिद्ध कीजिए: (i) △ABD ~ △CBD (ii) AB = BC
questions.text_english: In the given figure, ABCD is a quadrilateral. Diagonal BD bisects ∠B and ∠D both. Prove that: (i) △ABD ~ △CBD (ii) AB = BC
questions.image_description: Quadrilateral ABCD with diagonal BD drawn. The diagonal bisects both angle B and angle D. Vertices are labelled with A at bottom left, B at bottom right, C at top right, D at top left.
questions.solution: (i) In △ABD and △CBD: ∠ABD = ∠CBD (BD bisects ∠B), ∠ADB = ∠CDB (BD bisects ∠D), and BD = BD (common). By AA similarity, △ABD ~ △CBD. (ii) Since △ABD ~ △CBD, their corresponding sides are proportional: AB/CB = BD/BD = 1. Therefore AB = BC.

questions.text:
(A) सिद्ध कीजिए कि 5 − 2√3 एक अपरिमेय संख्या है जब यह दिया है कि √3 अपरिमेय संख्या है।
अथवा
(B) दर्शाइए कि संख्या 5×11×17 + 3×11 एक भाज्य संख्या (समग्र संख्या) है।
questions.text_english:
(A) Prove that 5 − 2√3 is an irrational number. It is given that √3 is an irrational number.
OR
(B) Show that the number 5×11×17 + 3×11 is a composite number.

key_points: Assume rational, derive contradiction for Part A
Factor out 11 for Part B to show composite

questions.solution:
Part A: Assume 5 − 2√3 = p/q (rational). Then 2√3 = 5 − p/q = (5q − p)/q, so √3 = (5q − p)/(2q), which is rational — a contradiction since √3 is irrational. Hence 5 − 2√3 is irrational.
Part B: 5×11×17 + 3×11 = 11(5×17 + 3) = 11(85 + 3) = 11 × 88 = 11 × 8 × 11 = 968. Since 968 = 11 × 88, it has factors other than 1 and itself, so it is composite.

questions.text:
(A) वह अनुपात ज्ञात कीजिए जिसमें बिंदु (8/5, y) बिंदुओं (1, 2) तथा (2, 3) को मिलाने वाले रेखाखंड को विभाजित करता है। y का मान भी ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(B) बिंदु A(−1, −1), B(−1, 6), C(3, 6) तथा D(3, −1) एक आयत ABCD बनाते हैं। यदि P, Q, R तथा S क्रमशः भुजाओं AB, BC, CD तथा DA के मध्य बिंदु हैं तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि चतुर्भुज PQRS के विकर्ण एक-दूसरे का समद्विभाजन करते हैं।
questions.text_english:
(A) Find the ratio in which the point (8/5, y) divides the line segment joining the points (1, 2) and (2, 3). Also, find the value of y.
OR
(B) ABCD is a rectangle formed by the points A(−1, −1), B(−1, 6), C(3, 6) and D(3, −1). P, Q, R and S are mid-points of sides AB, BC, CD and DA respectively. Show that diagonals of the quadrilateral PQRS bisect each other.

key_points: Part B: midpoints of PR and QS coincide

questions.solution:
Part A: Let ratio be k:1. By section formula, x = (2k+1)/(k+1) = 8/5. So 5(2k+1) = 8(k+1), giving 10k+5 = 8k+8, thus 2k = 3, k = 3/2. Ratio = 3:2. y = (3×3+2×2)/(3+2) = (9+4)/5 = 13/5.
Part B: P=(−1,5/2), Q=(1,6), R=(3,5/2), S=(1,−1). Midpoint of PR = ((−1+3)/2,(5/2+5/2)/2) = (1,5/2). Midpoint of QS = ((1+1)/2,(6+(−1))/2) = (1,5/2). Both midpoints are equal, so diagonals bisect each other.

questions.text: अध्यापकों की एक कार्यशाला में फ्रेंच, हिन्दी तथा अंग्रेजी के क्रमशः 48, 80 तथा 144 अध्यापक हैं। यदि प्रत्येक कमरे में एक ही विषय के अध्यापकों की समान संख्या रखनी हो, तो कम से कम कितने कमरों की आवश्यकता होगी?
questions.text_english: In a teachers' workshop, the number of teachers teaching French, Hindi and English are 48, 80 and 144 respectively. Find the minimum number of rooms required if in each room the same number of teachers are seated and all of them are of the same subject.
questions.solution: To minimise rooms, we maximise the number of teachers per room, which equals HCF(48, 80, 144). HCF: 48=2⁴×3, 80=2⁴×5, 144=2⁴×3². HCF = 2⁴ = 16. Rooms for French = 48/16 = 3, Hindi = 80/16 = 5, English = 144/16 = 9. Total minimum rooms = 3 + 5 + 9 = 17.

questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए: tan θ/(1 − cot θ) + cot θ/(1 − tan θ) = 1 + sec θ cosec θ
questions.text_english: Prove that: tan θ/(1 − cot θ) + cot θ/(1 − tan θ) = 1 + sec θ cosec θ

key_points: Express in terms of sin and cos

questions.solution: LHS = (sin θ/cos θ)/(1 − cos θ/sin θ) + (cos θ/sin θ)/(1 − sin θ/cos θ). Simplifying: sin²θ/[cos θ(sin θ − cos θ)] + cos²θ/[sin θ(cos θ − sin θ)] = sin²θ/[cos θ(sin θ − cos θ)] − cos²θ/[sin θ(sin θ − cos θ)] = (sin³θ − cos³θ)/[sin θ cos θ(sin θ − cos θ)] = (sin²θ + sin θ cos θ + cos²θ)/(sin θ cos θ) = (1 + sin θ cos θ)/(sin θ cos θ) = 1/(sin θ cos θ) + 1 = sec θ cosec θ + 1 = RHS.

questions.text: तीन वर्ष पहले, रश्मि की आयु नजमा की आयु की तीन गुनी थी। दस वर्ष पश्चात रश्मि की आयु नजमा की आयु की दुगनी रह जाएगी। उन दोनों की वर्तमान आयु ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Three years ago, Rashmi was thrice as old as Nazma. Ten years later, Rashmi will be twice as old as Nazma. How old are Rashmi and Nazma now?
questions.solution: Let Rashmi's current age = R and Nazma's = N. Three years ago: R − 3 = 3(N − 3), so R = 3N − 6. Ten years later: R + 10 = 2(N + 10), so R = 2N + 10. Setting equal: 3N − 6 = 2N + 10, giving N = 16. Wait — R = 3(16) − 6 = 42. Checking: R+10 = 52, 2(N+10) = 52 ✓. So Nazma = 16 years, Rashmi = 42 years.

questions.text:
(A) दी गई आकृति में, AB वृत्त का व्यास है तथा O वृत्त का केंद्र है। AQ, BP तथा PQ वृत्त पर खींची गई स्पर्श रेखाएँ हैं। सिद्ध कीजिए कि ∠POQ = 90° है।
अथवा
(B) एक चतुर्भुज ABCD के अंतर्गत एक 8 सेमी त्रिज्या वाला वृत्त इस प्रकार खींचा गया कि P, Q, R, S स्पर्श बिंदु हैं, जैसा आकृति में दर्शाया गया है। यदि AD ⊥ DC है तथा BC = 30 सेमी और BS = 24 सेमी है तो DC की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(A) In the given figure, AB is a diameter of the circle with centre O. AQ, BP and PQ are tangents to the circle. Prove that ∠POQ = 90°.
OR
(B) A circle with centre O and radius 8 cm is inscribed in a quadrilateral ABCD in which P, Q, R, S are the points of contact as shown. If AD is perpendicular to DC, BC = 30 cm and BS = 24 cm, then find the length DC.

key_points: Part A: Use tangent-radius perpendicularity and angle sum

questions.image_description: Part A: Circle with centre O, diameter AB. External point P with tangents PQ and PB drawn to the circle. AQ is also a tangent. Part B: Circle inscribed in quadrilateral ABCD with points of tangency P (on AB), Q (on BC), R (on CD), S (on AD). AD is perpendicular to DC.
questions.solution:
Part A: Let ∠OAQ = ∠OBP = 90° (radius ⊥ tangent). In quadrilateral APOQ: ∠OAQ = 90°, ∠OBP = 90°, ∠APQ + ∠POQ = 180°. Since AQ and BP are tangents from A and B respectively on a diameter, using the property that ∠POQ = 90°. (Full proof via angle sum in quadrilateral OAPB: 90°+90°+∠AOB+∠APB=360°, with ∠AOB = 180° gives ∠APB = 90°, then ∠POQ = 90° by supplementary angles.)
Part B: BS = 24 cm, so BQ = 24 cm (tangents from B). BC = 30 cm, so QC = 6 cm. CR = QC = 6 cm (tangents from C). AD ⊥ DC and radius = 8 cm, so DQ = DR = 8 cm. DC = DR + RC = 8 + 6 = 14 cm... Rechecking: tangent from D: DR = DQ; since AD⊥DC, the circle touches DC at R and AD at S, with OR⊥DC and OS⊥AD, so OR = OS = 8. DC = DQ + QC = 8 + 6 = 14 cm.

questions.text: 14 सेमी लंबे एक लंबवृत्तीय खोखले बेलन की बाह्य तथा अन्तः त्रिज्याओं का अंतर 1 सेमी है। यदि इस बेलन को बनाने में लगी धातु का आयतन 176 सेमी³ है, तो इसकी बाह्य तथा अन्तः त्रिज्याएँ ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: The difference between the outer and inner radii of a hollow right circular cylinder of length 14 cm is 1 cm. If the volume of the metal used in making the cylinder is 176 cm³, find the outer and inner radii of the cylinder.
questions.solution: Let outer radius = R and inner radius = r. Given R − r = 1 and π(R² − r²) × 14 = 176. So π(R+r)(R−r) × 14 = 176, giving π(R+r)(1)(14) = 176. R + r = 176/(14π) = 176/(14 × 22/7) = 176 × 7/(14 × 22) = 1232/308 = 4. So R + r = 4 and R − r = 1, giving R = 2.5... Hmm: 176/(14π) using π=22/7: = 176×7/(14×22) = 4. So R+r=4, R−r=1, R=2.5, r=1.5. These are the outer and inner radii.

questions.text: त्रिज्या 21 सेमी वाले वृत्त का एक चाप केंद्र पर 60° का कोण अंतरित करता है। ज्ञात कीजिए: (i) चाप की लंबाई। (ii) संगत जीवा द्वारा बनाए गए लघु वृत्तखंड का क्षेत्रफल।
questions.text_english: An arc of a circle of radius 21 cm subtends an angle of 60° at the centre. Find: (i) the length of the arc. (ii) the area of the minor segment of the circle made by the corresponding chord.

sub_questions.text: संगत जीवा द्वारा बनाए गए लघु वृत्तखंड का क्षेत्रफल।
sub_questions.text_english: The area of the minor segment of the circle made by the corresponding chord.

key_points: Area of minor segment = 40.17 cm² (approximately) or (231 − 441√3/4) cm²

sub_questions.solution: Area of sector = (60/360) × π × 21² = (1/6) × (22/7) × 441 = 231 cm². Area of equilateral triangle (since θ = 60° and both sides = r = 21 cm): (√3/4) × 21² = (√3/4) × 441 = 441√3/4 ≈ 190.95 cm². Area of minor segment = 231 − 441√3/4 ≈ 231 − 190.95 ≈ 40.05 cm².

questions.solution: Arc length = (60/360) × 2 × (22/7) × 21 = 22 cm. Area of sector = (60/360) × (22/7) × 441 = 231 cm². Area of triangle formed = (√3/4) × 21² = 441√3/4 ≈ 190.95 cm². Area of minor segment = 231 − 441√3/4 ≈ 40.05 cm².

questions.text:
(A) एक समांतर श्रेढ़ी (A.P.) के प्रथम तथा आठवें पदों का योगफल 32 है तथा गुणनफल 60 है। इस श्रेढ़ी का प्रथम पद तथा सार्वअंतर ज्ञात कीजिए। इस श्रेढ़ी के प्रथम 20 पदों का योग भी ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(B) 40 पदों की एक समांतर श्रेढ़ी के प्रथम 9 पदों का योगफल 153 है तथा इसके आखिरी छः पदों का योग 687 है। इस श्रेढ़ी का प्रथम पद तथा सार्वअंतर ज्ञात कीजिए। इस श्रेढ़ी के सभी पदों का योगफल भी ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(A) The sum of first and eighth terms of an A.P. is 32 and their product is 60. Find the first term and common difference of the A.P. Hence, also find the sum of its first 20 terms.
OR
(B) In an A.P. of 40 terms, the sum of first 9 terms is 153 and the sum of last 6 terms is 687. Determine the first term and common difference of A.P. Also, find the sum of all the terms of the A.P.

key_points: Part A: a=2, d=30/7 or a=30, d=−30/7; S₂₀=660 or S₂₀=660

questions.topic: Finding terms and sum of AP

questions.text:
(A) यदि किसी त्रिभुज की एक भुजा के समांतर अन्य दो भुजाओं को भिन्न-भिन्न बिंदुओं पर प्रतिच्छेद करने के लिए एक रेखा खींची जाए, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि यह भुजा अन्य भुजाओं को एक ही अनुपात में विभाजित करती है।
अथवा
(B) दी गई आकृति में PA, QB तथा RC प्रत्येक AC पर लंब हैं। यदि AP = x, BQ = y तथा CR = z हैं, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि 1/x + 1/z = 1/y
questions.text_english:
(A) If a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle to intersect the other two sides in distinct points, then prove that the other two sides are divided in the same ratio.
OR
(B) In the given figure PA, QB and RC are each perpendicular to AC. If AP = x, BQ = y and CR = z, then prove that 1/x + 1/z = 1/y

key_points: Part A: Basic Proportionality Theorem (Thales theorem) proof
Part B: Use similar triangles to establish the relation

questions.image_description: Part B: Three parallel perpendiculars PA, QB, RC drawn from points A, B, C on a line to a transversal. P, Q, R are on the transversal, with AP=x, BQ=y, RC=z. A geometric figure showing the configuration with labels x, y, z.
questions.solution:
Part A (BPT): In △ABC, let DE ∥ BC meeting AB at D and AC at E. Draw DM⊥AE and EN⊥AD. Area(△ADE)/Area(△BDE) = (1/2×AD×DM)/(1/2×BD×DM) = AD/BD. Similarly, Area(△ADE)/Area(△CDE) = AE/CE. Since △BDE and △CDE share base DE and lie between same parallels, their areas are equal. Therefore AD/BD = AE/CE, proving BPT.
Part B: Since PA∥QB∥RC, in △PAC, QB∥PA gives QB/PA = BC/AC, so y/x = BC/AC. In △RCA, QB∥RC gives QB/RC = AB/AC, so y/z = AB/AC. Adding: y/x + y/z = BC/AC + AB/AC = (AB+BC)/AC = AC/AC = 1. Dividing by y: 1/x + 1/z = 1/y.

questions.text: एक खम्भा जिसकी ऊँचाई 6 मीटर है, एक मीनार के शिखर पर खड़ा है। भूमि पर एक बिंदु P से खम्भे के शिखर का उन्नयन कोण 60° तथा मीनार के शिखर से बिंदु P का अवनमन कोण 45° है। मीनार की ऊँचाई तथा बिंदु P की मीनार के पाद से दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए। (√3 = 1.73 लीजिए)
questions.text_english: A pole 6m high is fixed on the top of a tower. The angle of elevation of the top of the pole observed from a point P on the ground is 60° and the angle of depression of the point P from the top of the tower is 45°. Find the height of the tower and the distance of point P from the foot of the tower. (Use √3 = 1.73)

key_points: Distance of P from foot = 3(√3+1) m ≈ 8.19 m

questions.solution: Let tower height = h and horizontal distance = d. Angle of depression from tower top to P is 45°, so tan 45° = h/d, giving d = h. Angle of elevation from P to top of pole (height h+6) is 60°, so tan 60° = (h+6)/d = (h+6)/h. Thus √3 = (h+6)/h, giving √3h = h+6, so h(√3−1) = 6, h = 6/(√3−1) = 6(√3+1)/2 = 3(√3+1) ≈ 3×2.73 = 8.19 m. Distance d = h = 3(√3+1) ≈ 8.19 m.

questions.text: एक आयताकार क्षेत्र के फर्श को 200 वर्गाकार टाइलों द्वारा पूरा ढका (भरा) जा सकता है। यदि प्रत्येक टाइल की भुजा 1 इकाई बढ़ा दी जाए तो फर्श केवल 128 टाइलों से ही ढक जाता है।
questions.text_english: A rectangular floor area can be completely tiled with 200 square tiles. If the side length of each tile is increased by 1 unit, it would take only 128 tiles to cover the floor.

sub_questions.text: यह मानते हुए कि टाइल की प्रत्येक भुजा की मूल लंबाई x इकाई है, उपरोक्त सूचना को द्विघात समीकरण द्वारा निरूपित कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Assuming the original length of each side of a tile be x units, make a quadratic equation from the above information.
sub_questions.solution: Area of floor = 200x². With new tile side (x+1), number of tiles = 128, so 128(x+1)² = 200x². This is the required quadratic equation.

sub_questions.text: संगत द्विघात समीकरण को मानक रूप में लिखिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Write the corresponding quadratic equation in standard form.

sub_questions.text:
(a) गुणनखंडन से x का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(b) द्विघात समीकरण को द्विघात सूत्र से हल कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english:
(a) Find the value of x, the length of side of a tile by factorisation.
OR
(b) Solve the quadratic equation for x, using quadratic formula.
sub_questions.solution: 9x² − 32x − 16 = 0. Factorising: 9x² − 36x + 4x − 16 = 0 → 9x(x−4) + 4(x−4) = 0 → (9x+4)(x−4) = 0. So x = 4 or x = −4/9. Since length is positive, x = 4 units. By quadratic formula: x = (32 ± √(1024 + 576))/18 = (32 ± √1600)/18 = (32 ± 40)/18. x = 72/18 = 4 or x = −8/18 = −4/9. Taking positive: x = 4.

questions.image_description: A photograph of a rectangular tiled floor showing square tiles arranged in a grid pattern.
questions.solution: Case study on quadratic equations based on tiling a floor. The floor area = 200x². When tile side becomes (x+1), 128 tiles suffice. Equation: 9x² − 32x − 16 = 0. Solution: x = 4 units.

questions.text:
बिंगो एक संयोग का खेल है। मेजबान के पास 1 से 75 तक क्रमांकित 75 गेंदें हैं। प्रत्येक खिलाड़ी के पास एक बिंगो कार्ड है जिस पर कुछ संख्याएँ अंकित हैं। एक गेंद यादृच्छया चुनकर उस पर लिखी संख्या बोले जाने पर प्रतिभागी कार्ड पर वह संख्या रद्द कर देता है। जो भी कार्ड की सारी संख्याएँ रद्द कर पाता है वह बिंगो बोल कर खेल जीत जाता/जाती है। नीचे दिए आँकड़े, एक ऐसा खेल दर्शाते हैं जिसमें तारा के बिंगो कहने से पहले 48 गेंद प्रयोग में लाई गईं।

बोली गई संख्या | कितनी बार
0-15 | 8
15-30 | 9
30-45 | 10
45-60 | 12
60-75 | 9
questions.text_english:
BINGO is a game of chance. The host has 75 balls numbered 1 through 75. Each player has a BINGO card with some numbers written on it. The participant cancels the number on the card when called out a number written on the ball selected at random. Whosoever cancels all the numbers on his/her card, says BINGO and wins the game.

The table given below, shows the data of one such game where 48 balls were used before Tara said 'BINGO'.

Numbers announced | Number of times
0-15 | 8
15-30 | 9
30-45 | 10
45-60 | 12
60-75 | 9

sub_questions.solution: Total frequency = 48. n/2 = 24. Cumulative frequencies: 0-15: 8, 15-30: 17, 30-45: 27. The 24th value falls in the class 30-45. Median class = 30-45.

sub_questions.text: जब पहली गेंद निकाली गई थी उस समय एक सम संख्या के बोलने की क्या प्रायिकता थी?
sub_questions.text_english: When first ball was picked up, what was the probability of calling out an even number?
sub_questions.solution: Balls are numbered 1 to 75. Even numbers from 1 to 75 are 2, 4, 6, …, 74 — total 37 even numbers. P(even) = 37/75.

sub_questions.text:
(a) दिए गए आँकड़ों का माध्यक ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(b) दिए गए आँकड़ों का बहुलक ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english:
(a) Find median of the given data.
OR
(b) Find mode of the given data.

questions.image_description: BINGO game card image showing numbered balls and a BINGO card layout with columns B, I, N, G, O.
questions.solution: Case study based on statistics using BINGO game data. Median class = 30-45. P(even on first draw) = 37/75. Median = 40.5. Mode = 51.

questions.text: एक भवन के पीछे का हिस्सा एक त्रिभुज ABC के आकार का है जिसका कोण B समकोण है। AB = 7 मी. तथा BC = 15 मी. है। इसके अंदर एक वृत्ताकार खड्डा इस प्रकार खोदा गया कि यह भुजाओं AC, BC तथा AB को क्रमशः P, Q तथा R पर स्पर्श करता है तथा AP = x मी. है।
questions.text_english: A backyard is in the shape of a triangle ABC with right angle at B. AB = 7 m and BC = 15 m. A circular pit was dug inside it such that it touches the walls AC, BC and AB at P, Q and R respectively such that AP = x m.

sub_questions.text: x के पदों में AR की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the length of AR in terms of x.

key_points: AR = x (tangent segments from A are equal)

sub_questions.solution: Since AP and AR are tangent segments from point A to the circle, they are equal in length. Therefore AR = AP = x m.

sub_questions.text: चतुर्भुज BQOR किस प्रकार का चतुर्भुज है?
sub_questions.text_english: Write the type of quadrilateral BQOR.
sub_questions.solution: OQ ⊥ BC and OR ⊥ AB (radius ⊥ tangent), and ∠B = 90°. Also OQ = OR = r (radii). Therefore BQOR is a square with side r.

sub_questions.text:
(a) PC की लंबाई x के पदों में ज्ञात कीजिए और x का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(b) x का मान ज्ञात कीजिए और वृत्त की त्रिज्या r का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english:
(a) Find the length PC in terms of x and hence find the value of x.
OR
(b) Find x and hence find the radius r of circle.
sub_questions.solution: AC = √(AB²+BC²) = √(49+225) = √274 = 17 m. AP = AR = x, so BR = AB − AR = 7 − x, and BQ = BR = 7 − x (tangents from B). CP = CQ = AC − AP = 17 − x, and CQ = BC − BQ = 15 − (7−x) = 8 + x. So 17 − x = 8 + x gives 9 = 2x, x = 4.5. Then r = BQ = 7 − 4.5 = 2.5 m. (Using AC=17: x=4.5, r=2.5 m.)

questions.image_description: Right triangle ABC with right angle at B, AB=7m, BC=15m. An inscribed circle with centre O touches AC at P, BC at Q, and AB at R. The radius is shown as r. A real photograph of a backyard with a circular pit is also shown.
questions.solution: Case study on circles inscribed in a triangle. AR = x (equal tangents from A). BQOR is a square. AC = 17 m, AP = AR = x, BQ = BR = 7−x, CP = CQ. Equating: 17−x = 15−(7−x) gives x = 4.5, r = 2.5 m.
